title: Timic Science Implementation Lab — Models, Simulations, Metrics & Falsifiers
status: canonical implementation layer for archive-derived toy models
purpose: Turn the science canon into things that can actually be implemented, simulated, measured, compared and rejected. Every module below defines state variables, equations, outputs, null models and failure conditions. It does not promote symbolic mappings into established physics.

modules.title: Axis + Door + Spiral Hybrid Dynamics
modules.question: Does transformed recurrence appear specifically because structural and temporal flows do not commute, or does ordinary oscillation explain it?
modules.falsifier: If the noncommuting model adds no robust behavior beyond simpler matched baselines, Axis-Time noncommutativity is unnecessary for this toy system.

modules.title: Needle as Information Bottleneck
modules.variables: X high-dimensional incoming representation; Z compressed Door state; Y downstream-relevant target
modules.project_result: A narrow gate can be better when it discards irrelevant information while preserving task-relevant structure.
modules.null_model: random projection with equal output dimension
modules.failure_condition: If the Door representation preserves no more relevant information than random compression, the proposed Needle encoding has no demonstrated advantage.

modules.title: House / Rooms as Knowledge Atlas
modules.state: canonical entity c with domain charts φ_i(c)
modules.implementation: Treat theology, science, chronology, economics and culture records as contextual charts over canonical entities rather than competing copies.
modules.failure_condition: If two charts cannot be translated without changing the asserted identity or epistemic class, they are not merely coordinate views and must remain separate objects.

modules.title: Potatoverse Dimensional Filtration
modules.implementation: For each level define allowed node types, edge types, observables and transformations; build inclusion maps F_k→F_l where justified.
modules.persistent_feature_test: track concepts/relations that survive across successive levels; persistent homology may be used only when a genuine simplicial filtration is constructed.
modules.key_question: What capability is gained at each level?
modules.failure_condition: If level labels do not induce nested mathematical structures, treat the sequence as taxonomy rather than filtration.

modules.title: Toroidal Recurrence / Winding Lab
modules.derived_question: Can two cyclic processes produce apparent return without exact total-state repetition?
modules.failure_condition: If one-dimensional periodic dynamics reproduces the same observations, toroidal state space is unnecessary.

modules.title: Advanced/Retarded Two-Boundary Solver
modules.model: minimize action or path cost J[q]=∫L(q,qdot,t)dt subject to q(t_i)=q_i and q(t_f)=q_f
modules.comparison: ordinary initial-value problem with q(t_i),qdot(t_i) specified
modules.interpretation: Tests global two-sided constraint solving; not future-to-past messaging.
modules.failure_condition: Do not infer retrocausal signaling from a boundary-value solution.

modules.title: Life / Strife Multi-Type Branching
modules.project_result: Branch dominance becomes a question of reproduction, conversion and loss parameters rather than moral labels alone.
modules.failure_condition: If empirical network data do not support distinct propagation processes, keep Life/Strife as symbolic classification.

modules.title: Meme / Logos Replication Dynamics
modules.state: frequency vector x_i of meme variants
modules.graph_layer: adoption state evolves over social graph with diffusion/threshold terms
modules.project_result: Signal propagation, contagion and replication are three different mechanisms and should be separately measured.
modules.failure_condition: Do not call something self-replicating unless copies/variants and transmission events can be operationally identified.

modules.title: Recursion-of-Recursion / Self-Improving Archive
modules.derived_result: A project is meta-improving only if the mechanism that performs corrections itself improves, not merely if content volume grows.
modules.failure_condition: More commits or more files alone do not demonstrate recursive improvement.

modules.title: Starchforce: Reservoir Model → Fifth-Force Test Harness
modules.promotion_rule: Starchforce remains a storage/capacity metaphor or generic reservoir variable until a parameterized interaction predicts observations distinguishable from known physics.
modules.failure_condition: No unique deviation → no physical-force promotion.

modules.title: Compactness / Door Regime Lab
modules.external_baseline: event-horizon criterion is determined by spacetime geometry; for Schwarzschild r_s=2GM/c²
modules.project_use: Tests what a threshold model would require if black holes are used as Door comparators.
modules.failure_condition: A chosen Ξ with no independent calibration or observable transition is only a toy order parameter.

modules.title: Axis Identity vs Orientation
modules.external_anchor: Earth's spin axis precesses over about 26,000 years; astronomy therefore specifies epochs for coordinates.
modules.project_result: A reference role can remain stable while the vector representing its orientation changes.
modules.implementation: Attach coordinate frame and epoch to celestial North/Eye claims.
modules.failure_condition: Do not infer metaphysical recurrence from Earth's axial precession alone.

modules.title: House / Eye / Flow Neuro-Symbolic Comparator
modules.state: neural subsystem states x_T (thalamic), φ_C (circadian phase), q_CSF (fluid variables)
modules.thalamus_model: xdot_T=A_Tx_T+B_Tu; gating weights g_i(state,attention) regulate routed signals
modules.science_boundary: Thalamus routing/integration, pineal circadian melatonin physiology and CSF flow are established physiological topics. Their Father/House, Son/Eye and Spirit mappings remain symbolic/project correspondences.
modules.derived_result: The pineal comparator is scientifically stronger as phase/timing than as literal vision; the thalamus comparator is stronger as differentiated routing/integration than as a single undivided center; CSF is stronger as a regulated fluid-flow comparator than as evidence for a spiritual substance.
modules.failure_condition: Never infer spiritual ontology from neuroanatomical function.

implementation_priority: 2. House chart consistency against the actual repository

verified_external_anchors.note: Tishby, Pereira and Bialek formalize compression that preserves information relevant to a target variable.
NASA describes Earth's axis tracing a precessional circle over about 26,000 years and explains epoch dependence of celestial coordinates.
NCBI Endotext identifies light-dark information and melatonin secretion as the principal established pineal function.
Neuroscience reviews describe differentiated thalamic nuclei participating in relay, modulation, integration, memory, attention and cognition.
NCBI StatPearls describes continuous CSF production and pulsatile flow influenced by cardiac pulse, respiration, posture and circadian variation.
Wheeler-Feynman absorber theory is a genuine time-symmetric advanced/retarded radiation framework; this does not imply practical future signaling.
